title: Wazuh · SCA: проверки конфигурации
description: Security Configuration Assessment: балл по политикам (CIS), какие проверки провалены и на каких хостах. Источник — алерты Wazuh с группой sca.

panels.title: Балл по политикам (последний скан)
panels.sql: SELECT agent_name AS `хост`, JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','policy') AS `политика`, toUInt16OrZero(argMax(JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','score'), timestamp)) AS `балл`, toUInt16OrZero(argMax(JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','passed'), timestamp)) AS `пройдено`, toUInt16OrZero(argMax(JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','failed'), timestamp)) AS `провалено`, max(toString(timestamp)) AS `скан` FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'sca') AND JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','type') = 'summary' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY `хост`, `политика` ORDER BY `балл`

panels.title: Проверки за период
panels.sql: SELECT countIf(JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','result') = 'failed') AS `провалено`, countIf(JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','result') = 'passed') AS `пройдено`, uniqExact(agent_name) AS `хостов` FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'sca') AND JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','type') = 'check' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Провалы по хостам
panels.sql: SELECT agent_name AS `хост`, uniqExact(JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','id')) AS `проваленных_проверок` FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'sca') AND JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','result') = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY `хост` ORDER BY `проваленных_проверок` DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Провалено / пройдено по времени
panels.sql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS t, JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','result') AS result, count() AS n FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'sca') AND JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','type') = 'check' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY t, result ORDER BY t

panels.title: Проваленные проверки (по хостам, последний результат)
panels.sql: SELECT JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','id') AS `проверка`, any(JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','title')) AS `название`, groupUniqArray(agent_name) AS `хосты`, any(JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','compliance','cis')) AS cis, any(JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','compliance','pci_dss')) AS pci_dss, max(toString(timestamp)) AS `последний_раз` FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'sca') AND JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','result') = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY `проверка` ORDER BY length(`хосты`) DESC, `проверка` LIMIT 100

panels.title: Самые частые провалы
panels.sql: SELECT concat(JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','id'), ' · ', substring(JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','title'),1,60)) AS `проверка`, count() AS `раз` FROM wazuh_alerts WHERE has(rule_groups,'sca') AND JSONExtractString(raw,'data','sca','check','result') = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY `проверка` ORDER BY `раз` DESC LIMIT 10
